What We Do

A Mini Construction Site You Can Actually Operate

We bring a fully equipped RC digger arena to your event. Visitors operate real remote-controlled excavators, dump trucks and loaders in a supervised sand arena. No experience needed.

  • ✓
    Remote-controlled excavators, dump trucks and loaders operated by participants — not staff
  • ✓
    Purpose-built sand arena with hazard-tape perimeter and branded signage, ready in under 90 minutes
  • ✓
    Two tiers: Little Diggers for ages 3–6, and Pro Operators for ages 6+ and adults
  • ✓
    Seasonal challenges — Egg Hunt, Treasure Dig, timed missions — add extra fun
  • ✓
    Fully portable: outdoor festivals or indoor venues. Card payments accepted on-site

How It Works

Simple for Organisers.
Unforgettable for Guests.

Whether you're booking us for your event or we're running our own pop-up, the process is the same.

01

Enquire

Send us your event details through the form or call us. We confirm availability and the space we'll need.

02

We Set Up

We arrive and build the arena — sand, diggers, hazard tape and signage — typically within 90 minutes.

03

Guests Play

Participants choose their tier and operate the machines. We supervise, reset and manage the queue throughout.

04

Pack Down

At the end of the event we clear everything away and leave the area clean. No mess left behind.

How to Book Us

Two Ways to Work Together

Choose whether you want us to run the experience independently at your public event, or as an exclusive attraction at your private event.

Pop-Up at Your Event

We set up our arena at your festival, fair or market and operate independently, charging guests directly per session. You get a high-quality attraction that fills dwell time — at no cost to you.

  • We handle all payments and supervision
  • No upfront cost to the organiser
  • Revenue-share arrangements available for larger events
  • Branded signage and construction-zone theming included
  • Suitable for minimum 3-hour event slots

Exclusive Private Hire

Book the full experience for your private event — birthday party, wedding, corporate day or school fair. Your guests play for free; you pay a single hire fee that covers setup, operation and breakdown.

  • Full arena setup and branded theming
  • Dedicated operator supervision throughout
  • Sessions for your guests during the hire period
  • Seasonal challenge add-ons (Egg Hunt, Treasure Dig)
  • Half-day and full-day options available
  • Tailored to your event theme on request

Questions

Frequently Asked

How much space do you need?
Our standard arena works comfortably in a 5m × 5m area, but we can scale up or down to suit your venue. We bring everything with us, including ground protection, so grass, tarmac and indoor floors are all fine.
Do you need power or water?
No. All our machines run on rechargeable batteries and we arrive fully charged with spares. No power supply, water or other facilities are needed from the venue.
What happens if it rains?
We operate under a gazebo at outdoor events, so light rain is no problem. For heavy weather, the entire setup works indoors — village halls, sports halls and marquees are all suitable.
Is it safe for young children?
Yes. The arena is fully supervised at all times, machines are sized by age tier, and the play area is enclosed with a clear perimeter. Children aged 3–6 use our Little Diggers machines with simplified controls.
How do guests pay at public events?
Guests pay per session directly at the arena. We accept both card (Visa / Mastercard) and cash, so there's nothing for the organiser to manage.
How far do you travel?
We're based in Nottinghamshire and cover the surrounding counties. For events further afield, get in touch — we're happy to discuss travel arrangements for larger bookings.
